page.overview:
What is Cyrax's Bomb?

This small, yet highly explosive bomb is part of an arsenal of high tech weaponry operated by the cyborg ninja Cyrax. Cyrax's Bomb first appeared along with him in Mortal Kombat 3 and later reappeared as a collectible Relic within the Konquest mode of Mortal Kombat: Armageddon. Cyrax also uses the bomb as a part of his arsenal in the Mortal Kombat (2011) video game.

Prior to being turned into a Cyborg, Cyrax used small handheld glass baubles filled with an explosive liquid as bombs.

The Edenian demigod Taven found one while aboard Sektor's Tekunin Warship before he escaped Sektor's Tekunin Clan.

Cyrax's Bomb also appears in Mortal Kombat X. Cyrax's Bomb is used in the Lin Kuei's Faction Kill Cyber Double Strike, a Kustom Kombat modifier, and a Test Your Might death. Triborg also utilizes Cyrax's Bombs in his Cyrax LK-4D4 Variation.
